title: Hybrid Uncertainty Sensitivity Analysis Based on the HSIC for High-Dimensional Responses with Aleatory--Epistemic Separation
abstract: arXiv:2606.14053v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Quantifying the influence of hybrid aleatory and epistemic uncertainties on high-dimensional system responses remains a major challenge in global sensitivity analysis (GSA). Existing Hilbert--Schmidt Independence Criterion (HSIC)-based approaches are primarily restricted to single-output settings and lack a rigorous decomposition of heterogeneous uncertainty sources and their interactions. To address this limitation, a novel double-space tensor-product RKHS framework is proposed for sensitivity analysis under hybrid uncertainty. By constructing factorized kernels over both the latent input space and the multidimensional output space, a concurrent double M\"obius inversion is derived to orthogonally decompose the global dependence measure into pure aleatory effects, pure epistemic effects, and their interaction contributions. translated_title: 基于HSIC的混合不确定性敏感性分析：面向具有偶然-认知不确定性分离的高维响应
translated_abstract: 量化混合的偶然不确定性与认知不确定性对高维系统响应的影响，仍然是全局敏感性分析（GSA）中的一项重大挑战。现有的基于希尔伯特-施密特独立性准则（HSIC）的方法主要局限于单输出设置，缺乏对异质不确定性来源及其相互作用的严格分解。为解决这一局限，本文提出了一种新颖的双空间张量积再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）框架，用于混合不确定性下的敏感性分析。通过在潜在输入空间和多维输出空间上构建因子化核，推导出并行的双重Möbius反演，将全局依赖性度量正交分解为纯偶然效应、纯认知效应及其交互贡献。由此得到的逐维敏感性指标在……上保持了不确定性归因结构（摘要原文在此处被截断）。
tldr: 提出了一种基于HSIC的双空间张量积RKHS新框架，通过并行的双重Möbius反演将全局依赖性度量正交分解为纯偶然效应、纯认知效应及其交互贡献，实现了混合不确定性下高维系统响应的敏感性分析。
en_tdlr: A novel double-space tensor-product RKHS framework based on HSIC is proposed, which employs a concurrent double Möbius inversion to orthogonally decompose the global dependence measure into pure aleatory effects, pure epistemic effects, and their interactions, enabling sensitivity analysis of high-dimensional responses under hybrid uncertainty.
